effect.shortEffect: When hit by an attack, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.
effect.full: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

french.sv: Si le Pokémon subit des dégâts, il se charge\nen électricité.

english.sv: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

japanese.sv: ダメージを　受けると じゅうでん　状態に　なる。
